missing.why: The verse says 'And his brother's name was Jubal', with 'his' referring to Jabal in the verse before, and no row records the brothers in either direction.

note: Every other row agrees with the Hebrew, and the owner rows (abel son-of adam, jabal son-of lamech, jubal son-of lamech and son-of adah, naamah daughter-of lamech, tubalcain son-of lamech, seth son-of eve) are consistent with the text, so none is flagged. zillah mother-of naamah (4:22) is an inference from 'the sister of Tubalcain was Naamah' rather than something the verse states, but nothing contradicts it, so it is not listed as wrong.
